mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, shop_id, poi_id, create_time, update_time FROM ai_sales_user_shop_binding WHERE poi_id = #{poiId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, shop_id, poi_id, create_time, update_time FROM ai_sales_user_shop_binding WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, shop_id, poi_id, create_time, update_time FROM ai_sales_user_shop_binding WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: SELECT usb.id AS binding_id, usb.shop_id, usb.poi_id, sh.epoi_id, COALESCE(sh.poi_name, sh.name) AS shop_name, sh.address, usb.user_id AS bound_user_id, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username, usb.user_id) AS bound_user_name, u.phone AS sales_bound_user_phone, 'SALES' AS binding_domain, '网销用户' AS binding_domain_name, COALESCE(pa.balance, 0) AS power_balance, COALESCE(pa.total_recharge, 0) AS total_recharge, COALESCE(pa.total_grant, 0) AS total_grant, COALESCE(pa.total_consume, 0) AS total_consume, sr.right_expire_at, usb.create_time AS bind_time FROM ai_sales_user_shop_binding usb INNER JOIN mt_shop sh ON sh.id = usb.shop_id LEFT JOIN ai_user u ON u.user_id = usb.user_id LEFT JOIN mt_power_account pa ON pa.shop_id = usb.shop_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shop_id, MAX(expire_at) AS right_expire_at FROM mt_shop_right WHERE expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at > NOW() GROUP BY shop_id ) sr ON sr.shop_id = usb.shop_id

sql.if: AND ( usb.poi_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(sh.poi_name, sh.name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username, usb.user_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

choose.when: ORDER BY power_balance ASC, usb.create_time DESC, usb.id DESC
ORDER BY power_balance DESC, usb.create_time DESC, usb.id DESC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY usb.create_time DESC, usb.id DESC
